messages.author: 83b63066408210ec
messages.subject: Suppress all of Stan's outputs
parts: I googled around and looked through here and haven't found a definitive answer, is there currently a way to silence Stan completely (including the assigned pid part and the elapsed time part)?

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Suppress all of Stan's outputs
parts:
On Friday, February 17, 2017 at 7:56:47 AM UTC-5, Pedro Carvalho wrote:
I googled around and looked through here and haven't found a definitive answer, is there currently a way to silence Stan completely (including the assigned pid part and the elapsed time part)?
I think you have to wrap it in a capture.output() statement.

messages.author: 83b63066408210ec
messages.subject: Re: Suppress all of Stan's outputs
parts: Just using capture.output ({stan (etc)}) doesn't seem to do the trick, is there anything in particular I need to put in the other arguments? NULL or a string or NA don't seem to work.

messages.author: 83b63066408210ec
messages.subject: Re: Suppress all of Stan's outputs
parts:
The code I'm running is

capture.output ({stan_fit1 = stan (model1,
                      data = data,
                      iter = iter, chains = chains,
                      control = list (stepsize = stepsize, adapt_delta = adapt_delta),
                      refresh = -1)}, file = '/dev/null')

And that still has the pid and elapsed time outputs.
